info.description: This API provides an overview of insurance options associated with car rental reservations. It allows users to access information about various insurance plans available for their reservations, ensuring they can make informed decisions regarding protection during their rental period. Typical consumers include car rental agencies and users seeking to understand insurance coverage options before finalizing bookings. The endpoint supports the retrieval of detailed insurance offerings to facilitate transparency and customer assurance.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch different insurance options associated with their reservations, providing details on coverage, costs, and terms.
